How the courses are built

One foundation, three paths

The three courses are separate and complete. Only the first month is shared, because every film craft has the same root: expression. From month two the curriculum splits completely.

Month 1 · all three courses

Shared foundation: in front of the camera

  • Observation, Emotion, Expression: the three steps of acting
  • The four pillars of Yogesh CineAct: Believing, Respect, Seriousness, Enjoying
  • The Observation System: Live, Imaginary, Micro, Nano and Combination Observation
  • Foundations of the Natyashastra, the nine rasas and sattvika bhava
  • Body, breath, voice and diction
  • Camera look and camera language: scaling a performance to the shot size
  • Improvisation: building scenes without a script
  • Shooting on a phone and starting your own channel

With every course

Special for YouTube and Instagram: make your own channel

Many artists today don't wait for a film; they build their own stage. So every student, in all three courses, launches and runs a channel within the 90 days.

  • Acting for YouTube and Instagram

    Being natural in front of a phone camera, speaking and playing characters.

  • Your channel's identity

    Deciding the character, subject or show you'll bring.

  • Shooting on a phone

    Light, sound and framing: clean video without expensive gear.

  • The first three seconds

    Hooks, titles and thumbnails: the craft of making a viewer stop.

  • Reels, Shorts and long videos

    Story and editing for both formats.

  • Consistency and analytics

    A publishing calendar, and learning from the numbers.

A case in point: every actor in the comedy series Gapistaan (Gen Gap) trained at this academy, and the series is shot using the same method.

Yogesh CineAct

We don't change you. We bring out you.

Yogesh Mishrra's method, Yogesh CineAct (Actors Transformation System), does not teach you to copy a star. It clarifies how the person you already are observes, feels and expresses, so that you are truthful on camera. And what you learn here works far beyond acting.

Mentorship

Founders of the academy

Yogesh Mishrra

Founder and Chief Mentor

Film director and a trusted mentor in camera acting. Shaped by the theatre environments of the Bharatendu Natya Academy and the National School of Drama, he trained under theatre maestro Surya Mohan Kulshreshtha.

He has directed films such as Dabang Sarkar and Vidyapeeth and has headed post-production on more than 15 feature films. He has taught acting for over 15 years, and Yogesh CineAct is his own method.

He is also the creator and director of the comedy series Gapistaan (Gen Gap), whose entire cast trained at this academy.

IMDbYogesh CineActGapistaan

Dinesh Kumar Sahgal

Co-founder

Over 30 years of leadership across government, film, media and entertainment. As Deputy Director in the Information and Public Relations Department and at Film Bandhu, Government of Uttar Pradesh, he helped establish the state as a major filming destination.

He holds an M.Sc. in Mathematics, a B.Ed. and a postgraduate diploma in computer science, with further training in multimedia and theatre. He joined the academy as co-founder in 2026.

Frequently asked questions

Is this one course that teaches all three?

No. Cinematic acting, film direction and film editing are three separate, complete courses of 90 days each. Only the first month is shared; months two and three are different for each course.

What is the fee?

The fee for each course is ₹50,000, or ₹27,500 + ₹27,500 in two instalments. A merit scholarship of up to 20% is awarded on the basis of the selection audition.

How do I apply online?

On the Apply Online page, choose a course, fill in your details and send. The form reaches us directly on WhatsApp, and we tell you when to come for the audition.

Why do direction and editing students learn acting in month one?

Because a good director or editor understands actors. The first month gives everyone the same grounding in camera, character and expression.

What is the selection audition?

A short audition and conversation at the academy so we understand your interest and readiness. Scholarships are decided on this basis.

Is there a degree or age requirement?

No degree is needed. Anyone above 16 can apply.

What opportunities follow the course?

Ten selected students from each batch get a three-month internship at PICHCHRAPA production house with travel allowance. We also offer job opportunities to our best students, at PICHCHRAPA or elsewhere in the industry. These depend on performance and selection; they are not guaranteed. Other students get guidance on auditions and projects.

Is there YouTube and Instagram training?

Yes, in all three courses. Every student starts a channel within the 90 days and learns shooting, editing and regular publishing on it.

Can I learn acting online?

You can build understanding online, but acting only sharpens with practice. Watch our free online classes and, after each one, practise in front of your phone camera at home. For correction in front of a camera and for real shoots, an offline batch is better. These three courses are classroom and live-shoot courses; for learning at home there is a separate online acting course.

What is the fee for an acting class in Lucknow?

At Indian Films Academy, Lucknow, every 90-day course costs ₹50,000, or two instalments of ₹27,500. A merit scholarship of up to 20% is awarded on the basis of the selection audition. A ₹500 registration fee books your seat; its rules are in the refund policy.

Where are the acting and direction classes in Gomti Nagar?

Indian Films Academy, C1/192, Vardan Khand, Sector 1, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226010. Please call or WhatsApp +91 77540 00121 or +91 72752 66772 before visiting.

Where can I do a film direction course in Uttar Pradesh?

Indian Films Academy in Gomti Nagar, Lucknow runs a 90-day film direction course: screenwriting, shot division, multicam shooting, directing actors, and your own episode on a real project. Whichever institute you choose, sit in on a class first and ask how often each student gets the camera and the set.

How is Indian Films Academy different from other acting institutes?

We do not claim to be the best; we state facts: three separate, complete courses in acting, direction and editing; camera grounding from the first month; real live shoots; your own YouTube or Instagram channel; scholarships of up to 20%; and free online classes for everyone. Compare for yourself: watch our free classes first, then visit a class.
